doctrine: PHYSICAL EDITORIAL EXPERIENCES THAT HAPPEN TO FUNCTION AS PRODUCT INTERFACES.

levels.rule: Every parent has a compositional thesis: where things sit, how they overlap, how the eye moves. A centered card is not a thesis.
The room participates in the page meaning. It is not generic decor behind the artifact.
The primary interaction is a physically distinct artifact. Do not reuse the same deckled-sheet silhouette for every screen.
Every parent has an intentional material collision that reinforces the meaning.
Torn edges, stamps, emboss, tabs, ribbons, and prints are selective. They do not compensate for a weak composition.

family_expression_rule: The five-level grammar is shared. Each family invents its own artifact language. MONEY, CREDIT, PLAN, SETUP, and RECORDS must not look like ENTRY.
fail_if: Creative direction appears only in props, paper texture, foliage, or decorative fragments.
The page can be described as a paper panel centered over a Mediterranean background.
Art-history objects are repeated as the same bust beside the same card.
A family copies another family’s artifact language. The grammar is shared. The expression is not.
An invented logo, monogram, vertical wordmark, botanical substitute, or retyped JURNL lockup appears.
The page is one stationery object on a generic desk or wall.
A family uses one camera for every parent.
The family has no distinct room.
pass_if: Hiding the live text still leaves a bespoke editorial campaign image.
Blurred type still distinguishes sibling parents by silhouette, space, environment, contrast, and material.
The environment, the artifact, and the material collision are one composition.
plate_rule: Page authority first. The plate keeps the set, objects, collisions, fragments, foreground, shadows, perspective, and crop, and removes live product UI. The plate must still read as a JURNL campaign image.

rework.composition: Lower-weighted. Embossed credential lying on a dark stone vanity. Open plaster above. Not an upright card.
rework.environment: Intimate access table. Reflective stone. Cropped relief.
rework.artifact: Embossed identity plaque and a brass access token.
rework.material_collision: Polished dark green marble, linen paper, brass.

rework.composition: Open passport folio at an angle, with a stamped slip. Not the biometric vanity.
rework.artifact: Stamped passport-style credential and a clipped registration slip.
rework.material_collision: Aged leather, cream paper, wax seal, metal.

rework.composition: Correspondence still life. The email field lives on a return slip, not on one centered sheet.
rework.artifact: Open envelope, partially exposed letter, separate return card.
rework.material_collision: Soft paper, burgundy thread, brass letter opener.

rework.composition: Open bifold folio. New record inset beside a cancelled edge. Not the create-account sheet.
rework.artifact: Replacement credential with a brass registration bar.
rework.material_collision: Linen folio, brass bar, green marble.

rework.composition: Partially opened folder with stacked inserts. Content across several paper edges. Soft and personal.
rework.artifact: Bound dossier closed by a burgundy ribbon and a privacy seal.
rework.material_collision: Layered archival paper, burgundy ribbon, stone.

rework.composition: Tabbed ledger with numbered sections. Architectural and ordered. Not the privacy folder.
rework.artifact: Security index with tabs and a brass fastener.
rework.material_collision: Structured card stock, black ink, dark green marble, brass.

rework.composition: The world opens. Invitation in the foreground. Light beyond. Sculpture behind the opening, not beside the card. Not a copy of welcome.
rework.environment: Stone threshold into the next room.
rework.art_history: Carved opening. The sculpture is behind the light.
